metadata.source_package_note: Packet 009 in the families 005-018 dispatch file is authoritative. The standalone F9.md was not used because the task identifies it as an Afrobeats proxy and source-map mismatch.

normalization.version_policy: Packet 009 names artist seeds only; instantiated album and song objects are curated missing-obvious additions unless explicitly named in the packet. Boundary, cover, live, compilation, and title-collision risks are flagged in warnings.
